ean.title: EAN / Barcode
ean.description: EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC or GTIN barcode to verify against EU Safety Gate recalls (e.g. 5054298241091).

eans.title: Batch EANs / Barcodes
eans.description: Array of EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC or GTIN barcodes for batch screening of e-commerce catalogs.

category.title: Category / Kategorie
category.description: Product category to filter alerts (e.g. Toys, Cosmetics, Electrical appliances, Motor vehicles).

query.title: Search Query / Suchbegriff
query.description: Free text search term to search across product names, brands, models, and danger descriptions.

childProductsOnly.title: Child & Baby Products Only
childProductsOnly.description: Filter strictly for toys, baby items, children's clothing and products intended for kids.

ageGroup.title: Child Age Group
ageGroup.description: Filter by target age group: 'baby' (0-12m), 'toddler' (1-3y), 'child' (toys/general kids).

hazard.title: Child Specific Hazard
hazard.description: Filter by primary child hazard: 'choking' (small parts), 'chemical' (PFAS, phthalates), 'magnets' (flux index).

refreshData.title: Live Data Refresh
refreshData.description: If true, fetches the latest official Safety Gate XML alerts from the European Commission before querying.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of alert items to return in the dataset (capped at 50 per run to prevent wholesale data dumping).
